ingestion_flows.source_description: TC-CDC-007 (rewritten for v1.4.0): batch Auto Loader legacy mainframe full-extract feed with cdc_load_strategy FULL_SNAPSHOT_CDC diffed on primary_keys=[customer_name]. The removed FULL_SNAPSHOT_CDC_NO_PK strategy hashed the whole payload into __framework_surrogate_key, which made a Day-2 status change look like a delete-of-the-old-row plus insert-of-a-new-row -- the same row twice, under two identities. With customer_name as the declared key that same change is what it actually is: an UPDATE in place. Verifies exactly that -- a changed status updates the existing row, a genuinely new customer is inserted, and a customer absent from the latest extract is removed.
